concepts.title: Speed of Sound in an Ideal Gas
concepts.definition: The speed of sound in a gas under adiabatic conditions, incorporating the ratio of specific heats (Laplace's correction).
concepts.key_idea: Sound propagation in gas is an adiabatic process, not isothermal.

solution_steps.action: Calculate speed of sound in gas

solution_steps.action: Compute the ratio of specific heats for the gas
solution_steps.explain: gamma equals Cp divided by Cv, characterizing the adiabatic compression of the gas during sound propagation

solution_steps.action: Verify the speed of sound using the ideal gas relation
